126102: The title character. She is a witch, child-like in appearance, but presumably much older. She is proficient in both Sorcery and Magic, having developed the latter.
139365: He is one of the Beastfallen, people who are born with the curse of a beast-like appearance and superhuman strength. Despite being mistreated in his life, he has maintained himself as a better person. He has a gruff attitude, but is in fact a very kind person.
142955: A young magician and member of the Sorcerers of Zero who encounters Zero and Youhei (Mercenary) during their travels. Albus eventually joins them on their quest to find the Grimoire of Zero.
142956: He is an old associate of Zero's who was the only other survivor aside from Zero of the massacre that led to the theft of the Grimoire of Zero. Alike Zero and Albus, Thirteen does not use his real name and opts for his alias.
142957: A werewolf Beastfallen. He was originally a prince who ran away from his family when he was caught having an affair and ended up living with Sorena. He asked Sorena to make him a Beastfallen to hide his royal lineage so that he could live out his life in peace.
221395: He is a student at the Royal School of Magic in the Kingdom of Wenias, and the main protagonist of the series. As a result of his grades being at the bottom of the class, he was ordered to participate in special training as remedy to avoid expulsion.
221474: Daughter of a restaurant owner. After seeing Youhei punch another beastfallen for not paying, she tried using him to chase away other beastfallen. It is revealed right after that that her mother was eaten alive by a starving beastfallen.
279674: Laios is a supporting character in the spinoff sequel The Dawn of the Witch. He is caring and somewhat naive of his parents' fear and distrust of those who practice sorcery or magic.
